title: Understanding the Problem
text: To find the expected total purchase value, we need to calculate the expected value of purchases for each customer and then sum it up for $$10$$ customers.

title: Expected Value for One Customer
text: For one customer, calculate the expected value of their purchase. Consider the probability and cost of each item.

title: Calculate Expected Value for Pencil
text: The expected value for a pencil is calculated by multiplying the probability of purchase by the price of the pencil.

title: Calculate Expected Value for Wax Head
text: The expected value for a wax head is calculated by multiplying the probability of purchase by the price of the wax head.

title: Total Expected Value for One Customer
text: Add the expected values of the pencil and wax head to get the total expected value for one customer.

title: Calculate Total Expected Value for $$10$$ Customers
text: Multiply the total expected value for one customer by $$10$$ to get the expected total purchase value for $$10$$ customers.
